verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 Ti is a consumer graphics card. Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is an account and service-platform capability, not something a GPU ships, so the story is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows the product offers any credential-issuance system: the docs cover DLSS, CUDA, G-Assist and local AI, and the probes find no API surface.
